[NEW] V0.4
What's Added
- Season 1 BattlePass with 50 reward tiers.
- New chair skins and lobby chair previews.
- New Portal Gun and Hotdog Gun.
- BattlePass-exclusive nametags.
- XP and Dabloon rewards.
- Smoother BattlePass animations and progress tracking.

Other players must decide whether to trust the claim or challenge it. Make smart decisions, pay attention to other players, and stay in the game.

Use strategy, observation, and timing to outplay your opponents.

Last player standing wins.

How To Play

- Join a table.
- Play cards face down.
- Make a claim about your cards.
- Challenge other players when you think they are wrong.
- Stay in the game and outlast everyone else.

EARLY DEVELOPMENT

This game is actively being updated. Bugs may occur and feedback is appreciated.

PC, Mobile, and Console
